cases.name: Autumn Strickland
cases.narrative:
On 5/20/2025, her remains were found in a burn barrel at his home. Police believe that Rogers was driving Strickland’s 2012 Kia Soul when she was fatally hit in a business and residential area about a mile and a half from the Stricklin Hotel on Court Street in downtown Florence, AL. She disappeared in the early morning hours of 5/17/2025 after she was last seen on video walking with some people near the Stricklin Hotel on Court Street in downtown Florence.

“Video evidence supports that Logan Rogers struck the victim twice and that this act was intentional due to the location and manner in which it was carried out,” according to a criminal complaint. After he allegedly struck Strickland twice, Meza says, he abandoned her vehicle on Helton Drive — about a mile and a half away — and then got a ride to pick up his truck in the downtown area. From there, he allegedly drove back to the crime scene, picked up Strickland’s body, and brought her back to his home.
